MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.Name: Morelord Encounters
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.DefaultSaved: The current encounter options are now the default.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.SourceHelp: Select the monster sources allowed for this encounter. These selections become the default for the next encounter.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.NoSources: Select at least one monster source.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.NoParty: Select at least one character for the party.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.PartyHelp: Select every character who should count toward encounter difficulty. Any character Actor can be included, whether or not it is assigned to a player.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.NoCharacters: No character Actors are available in this world.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.PartyFallback: No player-owned characters were found, so generation assumes four level-5 adventurers.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.NoMonstersFound: No NPC monsters were found in the selected sources.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.DragHelp: Click a monster to open its sheet, or drag its link onto the scene. Repeat the drag for the listed quantity.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.StealthHelpText: Use this optional roll to help determine whether the encounter begins as a surprise attack. It uses the lowest Stealth modifier among the encounter's creatures. Compare the result with each character's passive Perception, or with the highest passive Perception in the party for a quick group check.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.NoStealthModifier: No Stealth modifier is available for this encounter.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.DrakkenheimHelp: Roll an encounter from the official Dungeons of Drakkenheim tables. This option is available to Champion GMs when both Drakkenheim modules are active.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.DrakkenheimActorPrio: Actors resolve from Monsters of Drakkenheim first, then Dungeons of Drakkenheim.
MORELORD_ENCOUNTERS.CraftworksSourceNoti: Craftworks requires Drakkenheim creatures from the Monsters of Drakkenheim compendium. The provided Actor is not always selected from that compendium; double-check its Source before using this encounter with Craftworks.
